title: The drone in the graph: the multirotor's dynamics, its Newton-Euler residual and its sensor check as one ONNX file
description: The airframe of #335 exported as one straight-line ONNX graph: one RK4 step of the 6-DoF dynamics over the BEMT rotor table, the pack's sag, the seven Newton-Euler channels and the two decisions. Parity against the numpy airframe over four 400-step flights is 1e-7 relative, a 0.45 ms step (2.2 kHz) on one ARM core of this Mac -- no board was measured, none is on this machine -- dynamic int8 quantisation changes nothing on this graph (no matrices in it) and costs 42 % more bytes, and the tolerance calibrated on one healthy flight flags a 0.6 kg payload 100 % of the time with 0.5 % false alarms on a different healthy flight.

metrics.name: latency_1_thread
metrics.how: onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider, intra_op=inter_op=1 thread, 300 timed calls per session, median of three sessions; one step is the RK4 dynamics, the seven residual channels and both decisions

metrics.name: rate_1_thread
metrics.how: 1 / median latency on one thread, on the ARM core of this Mac (arm64, platform printed in the JSON); not measured on a Raspberry Pi, a Jetson or PX4 -- none of them is on this machine

metrics.name: rate_4_threads
metrics.how: 1 / median latency on four threads: more threads than this graph can use, spread +-0.137 ms

metrics.name: parity_next_state
metrics.how: max relative gap between the graph's next_state and Multirotor.step over 400 steps of a closed-loop tape (scale 663 rad/s on the rotor speeds)

metrics.name: parity_force_channel
metrics.how: max absolute gap between the graph's residual_force and ResidualModel over the same 400 steps

metrics.name: parity_torque_channel
metrics.how: max absolute gap between the graph's residual_torque and ResidualModel over the same 400 steps

metrics.name: graph_bytes
metrics.how: the exported flight.onnx, 27 op types, no If/Loop/Scan

metrics.name: int8_bytes
metrics.how: the same graph after dynamic int8 quantisation: 42 % larger, no new op types, next state moved by 0

metrics.name: false_alarm_rate
metrics.how: fraction of a healthy flight (seed 1) whose off_physics fired, with the tolerance calibrated on a different healthy flight (seed 0) at its 99.5th percentile

metrics.name: payload_detection
metrics.how: fraction of a flight with a 0.6 kg payload whose off_physics fired, same unchanged tolerance

metrics.name: loose_imu_detection
metrics.how: fraction of a flight with a 2 m/s^2 vibration fault whose suspect fired: it is the accelerometer's second difference against its own declared noise

checks.name: graph_is_straight_line
checks.label: seven fixed inputs, thirteen outputs, no If, Loop or Scan

checks.name: parity_with_the_numpy_airframe
checks.label: the next state to 1e-7 relative and the residual channels to 1e-6 against Multirotor.step and ResidualModel

checks.name: ground_effect_not_a_branch
checks.label: the ground-effect branch is a where, so the vehicle still feels the ground at 10 cm where a traced if loses 10.1 % of the lift

checks.name: unexportable_parts_named
checks.label: export_probe runs the three pieces that cannot be traced: searchsorted is refused at opset 17, the BEMT rotor and a Python if on a tensor export and freeze (60 % of the thrust, 10.1 % of the lift)

checks.name: arm_board_measured
checks.label: not measured: there is no Raspberry Pi, Jetson or PX4 on this machine -- the latency is the ARM core of a Mac and says so in the JSON
